title: 1956–57 National Hurling League

{{Short description|26th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1956–57 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 28 October 1956 – 25 August 1957 |teams =18 |team1 = Tipperary |captain1 = |manager1 = |titles = 7th |team2 = |captain2 = |manager2 = |two = Kerry |previous = [[1955–56 National Hurling League|1955–56]] |next = [[1957–58 National Hurling League|1957–58]] }} The '''1956–57 National Hurling League''' was the 26th season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |image = |season=1956-57 |winners=[[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]]
7th National League title
Captain: [[Mickey Byrne]] |relegated= |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer= |best goalkeeper= |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[1955-56 National Hurling League|1955-56]] |nextseason=[[1957-58 National Hurling League|1957-58]] |updated=2 May 2017 }} [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1955-56 National Hurling League|1955-56 season]].{{cite web|url=http://www.wexfordpeople.ie/sport/other-sports/another-honour-for-men-of-1956-27690802.html|title=Another honour for men of 1956|publisher=Wexford People|date=16 February 2006|accessdate=2 May 2017}}{{dead link|date=September 2025|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}} [[Antrim GAA|Antrim]] entered Division 1 as the promoted team from the previous season. On 12 May 1957, [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the title following a 3–11 to 2–7 win over [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] in the final. It was their 7th league title overall and their first since [[1954-55 National Hurling League|1954-55]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling
